map.常见面包的含水量大概多少？: What is the typical hydration of common breads?
map.法棍约 65%–70%，吐司（甜面包）约 60%–68%，欧式乡村包常 70%–: Baguette about 65%-70%, toast (sweet bread) about 60%-68%, European country bread often 70%-80%, ciabatta and other high-hydration breads can reach 80%-85%. Higher hydration is harder to handle but gives a more open crumb.
map.含水量高低主要影响了什么？: What does hydration level mainly affect?
map.含水量高则面团更黏、发酵更快、成品内部气孔更大更湿润；含水量低则组织紧实、口感偏: Higher hydration makes dough stickier, ferments faster, and yields a larger, moister crumb; lower hydration gives a tighter, denser texture. When adjusting, also consider fermentation time and handling technique.
